quotes.quote: Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) Maturity Document
PSIRT Maturity Levels to demonstrate Operational Capability and Maturity
These referenced use cases cover a spectrum of developmental levels from a newly-established PSIRT, through a more advanced Incident Response team
The framework does not cover topics such as capacity - the number of vulnerabilities and incidents a team can manage simultaneously
The use of the term "maturity" in this document is intended to describe a profile of a product security team
Maturity Level 1 (Basic) - The Beginning is a very fine place to start
Maturity Level 2 (Intermediate) - I am reactive, but I’ve trained for it!
Maturity Level 3 (Advanced) - Proactive...we’re ready for anything (mostly)
What? …. Sounds Impossible…. but it is NOT!
PSIRTs should have a defined charter that describes what the PSIRT does, and its scope.
